sousTitre: companion for the Nemesis: Lockdown board game
resume: Interactive round guide and searchable reference to accompany a physical game of Nemesis: Lockdown, on phone or tablet.
besoin: Nemesis: Lockdown's rules are dense (a 7-step Event Phase, many edge cases) — instead of pulling out the rulebook every round, essen walks through the round sequence step by step with contextual reminders, and doubles as a searchable reference for rooms, actions, and combat. Works offline once loaded (PWA), built to accommodate the game's expansions later.
